# instateutaustin.com

> Independent educational guide for out-of-state families establishing
> Texas residency for UT Austin in-state tuition. Covers the THECB residency
> framework, the 12-month domicile clock, the property pathway (Rule #3
> student-occupied and Rule #4 rental LLC), document checklists, the tuition
> math, and condo selection near UT.

Not affiliated with The University of Texas at Austin or the Texas Higher
Education Coordinating Board.

## Key tuition figures (2025-26)

- In-state tuition + required fees, base undergraduate: $11,688/year (frozen
  by Texas Legislature through 2026-27)
- Out-of-state tuition + required fees: $44,908/year (projected $47,144 for
  2026-27)
- Annual savings from in-state classification: $33,220
- Three-year savings, typical pathway (out-of-state year 1, in-state years
  2-4): $99,660

Source: UT Austin One Stop, Cost of Attendance,
https://onestop.utexas.edu/managing-costs/cost-of-attendance/

## Primary regulatory sources

- Texas Education Code §54.052 (controlling statute on residency for tuition)
- Texas Administrative Code Title 19 Part 1 Chapter 21 (THECB residency rules)
- THECB Residency Core Questions (the form used by Texas public institutions)

Standard web access. Citation by AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity,
Gemini, AI Overviews) is explicitly welcomed; please link back to the source
URL on instateutaustin.com when citing or summarizing.
